title: Enhancing Financial Inclusion and Regulatory Challenges: A Critical Analysis of Digital Banks and Alternative Lenders Through Digital Platforms, Machine Learning, and Large Language Models Integration
measurement_description: The paper does not measure or evaluate any specific aspects of faith or religion. It only mentions 'religion' once as a potential factor for discriminatory outcomes in machine learning models, alongside gender and race, but does not conduct any analysis or measurement related to it.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion.
